name: com.choesim/travel-esim
title: ChoEsim Travel eSIM
description: Search prepaid travel eSIM data plans for 200+ countries, with prices and one-step cart links.

tools.name: search_plans
tools.description: Find purchasable eSIM data plans for a destination, cheapest first. Returns price in USD, data, validity, coverage, plan page URL and a cart URL that opens choesim.com with the plan in the cart.

destination.description: Country name in English (e.g. "Japan") or a common local name (e.g. "Nhật Bản", "Japón", "日本"), or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "JP"). A region word such as "Europe", "Asia" or "Global" matches regional plans by name.

min_gb.description: Smallest total data in GB (for pay-per-day plans: data per day times min_days).

min_days.description: Trip length in days: the plan must last at least this long. Pay-per-day plans are listed for trips of up to 30 days.

include_regional.description: Also list multi-country plans that cover the destination (default true).

max_price_usd.description: Highest price in USD the buyer wants to pay (for pay-per-day plans: the price for min_days, or 7 days if min_days is not given).

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Details of one plan by id (from search_plans): price, data, validity, coverage, network speed, when validity starts, fair-use note, plan page and cart URL.

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Facts that apply to every ChoEsim plan: device requirements, data-only, delivery, refund rule, support contact, payment methods, with links.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: Use when the buyer has not chosen a country yet or asks which countries are available: every country that has a purchasable single-country plan, with the number of plans, the lowest one-time plan price ("from", USD) and the destination page URL. Then call search_plans for that country.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: Use when the trip crosses several countries: the purchasable multi-country plan groups, each with its name as the catalogue gives it, the exact list of covered countries (ISO codes), the number of plans and the lowest one-time plan price ("from", USD). Then call search_plans with one of the countries or the group name.
